LIVE9-ART 2: drawn as worn on a USAF service dress coat (assets/cords/ref/aiguillette-worn-usaf-service-dress-screenshot.jpg, README), in braid thicknesses B (0.30 in here): two braids leaving the epaulet at the top (cut square here: the ends go under it) side by side, 0.9 B apart: the inner one makes a short loop (legs 2.24 B apart, bottom 10.0 B below the epaulet edge), the outer one a long loop (legs 4.14 B apart, bottom 15.2 B as photographed), each turning up on the chest side into a free end 3.9 B below the epaulet edge; from each free end a thin cord (0.14 B) runs to a whipping (0.7 x 1.8 B at 6.7 B) and on to a silver pencil tip 3.2 B long (0.96 in at B 0.30), the two tips 0.8 B apart ending 14.7 B below the epaulet edge. There is no separate run along the shoulder. B was read on the photo (about 50 px at x4 of the 314 x 236 px preview); every depth and width is read in B from the same picture.
